name: g-framework-support
install:
set -euo pipefail
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/g-framework-support' ] || cd '/agent/repos/g-framework-support' || exit $?
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
if [ ! -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg ]; then
  curl --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
  sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
fi
. /etc/os-release
echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu ${VERSION_CODENAME} stable" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list >/dev/null
sudo apt-get update
APT_OPTS=(-y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold)
if ! sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install "${APT_OPTS[@]}" \
  docker-ce=5:28.5.2-1~ubuntu.24.04~noble \
  docker-ce-cli=5:28.5.2-1~ubuntu.24.04~noble \
  containerd.io \
  docker-buildx-plugin \
  docker-compose-plugin \
  fuse-overlayfs \
  iptables; then
  echo "pinned docker packages unavailable, installing current docker-ce" >&2
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install "${APT_OPTS[@]}" docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin fuse-overlayfs iptables
fi

sudo mkdir -p /etc/docker
sudo tee /etc/docker/daemon.json >/dev/null <<'JSON'
{
  "storage-driver": "overlay2"
}
JSON

if [ -x /usr/sbin/iptables-legacy ]; then
  sudo update-alternatives --set iptables /usr/sbin/iptables-legacy
fi
if [ -x /usr/sbin/ip6tables-legacy ]; then
  sudo update-alternatives --set ip6tables /usr/sbin/ip6tables-legacy
fi

sudo groupadd -f docker
sudo usermod -aG docker ubuntu

if ! sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo bash -c 'exec dockerd >/var/log/dockerd.log 2>&1' &
  ready=0
  for _ in $(seq 1 45); do
    if sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ready=1
      break
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  if [ "$ready" != 1 ]; then
    echo "dockerd failed to start" >&2
    sudo tail -40 /var/log/dockerd.log >&2 || true
    exit 1
  fi
fi

sudo docker network inspect g-support-net >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo docker network create g-support-net
sudo docker compose -f g_ppt/docker-compose.yml build
docker --version
docker compose version
start:
set -euo pipefail
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/g-framework-support' ] || cd '/agent/repos/g-framework-support' || exit $?

dockerd_pid=
if ! sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo bash -c 'exec dockerd >/var/log/dockerd.log 2>&1' &
  dockerd_pid=$!
  ready=0
  for _ in $(seq 1 45); do
    if sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ready=1
      break
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  if [ "$ready" != 1 ]; then
    echo "dockerd failed to start" >&2
    sudo tail -40 /var/log/dockerd.log >&2 || true
    exit 1
  fi
fi

sudo docker network inspect g-support-net >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo docker network create g-support-net

if ! curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:18800/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo docker compose -f g_ppt/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
  ready=0
  for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
    if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:18800/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ready=1
      break
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  if [ "$ready" != 1 ]; then
    echo "g-ppt container did not become healthy" >&2
    sudo docker compose -f g_ppt/docker-compose.yml logs --tail 80 >&2 || true
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [ -n "$dockerd_pid" ]; then
  wait "$dockerd_pid"
fi
